job.text: Show three views of spending against budget, each answering a question the managers are likely to ask (a set of views when their need is not known)

measures.name: expenses
measures.heading: How much did each dept. spend?

measures.name: deviation from budget
measures.heading: How well did each dept. stick to its budget?

measures.name: deviation from budget
measures.heading: How much above or below budget was each dept.?

source.shows: a set of views merged: three panels on the same rows, each headed by the question it answers (RP5-6), each with its own scale and its title below; the deviations signed, their zero line darker; one colour, where the book colours over and under budget red and green (good and bad colours are the message layer's)
